name: FlutLink (PAL)
subtitle: FlutCloud client for iOS — AltStore PAL source
description:
Official FlutLink source for AltStore PAL / AltStore (World). FlutLink is a dedicated FlutCloud client — files, sharing and administration, built with Kotlin Multiplatform.

Note: current builds are unsigned and not notarized; a notarized ADP (manifest.json) will replace the plain IPA downloadURL once code signing automation lands. Until then this source targets non-notarized distribution.

apps.name: FlutLink
apps.subtitle: Files, sharing and admin for your FlutCloud server.
apps.localizedDescription:
FlutLink is the mobile client for the FlutCloud server (Nextcloud + FlutCloud app). It connects exclusively to servers running the FlutCloud Nextcloud app.

- Files: WebDAV browsing, upload/download, share sheet, folder management, global search
- Admin: OCS user & group administration
- Security: tokens are stored securely, never logged

Current builds are unsigned/not yet notarized — see the source description for details.
